notes: The supplied text (PDF pages 242-245) covers the Paralegal program: the Paralegal Studies A.A./Certificate of Achievement, the local Paralegal Associate Degree General Education list, and the AA-T in Law, Public Policy, and Society. It contains no section for the CalGETC Certificate of Achievement, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers are recorded for this award.
The Paralegal GE list resembles a GE pattern but is the local GE for the Paralegal Studies degree and states that its courses may not be Cal-GETC approved; it was not read as the CalGETC certificate.
Reviewer should locate the CalGETC certificate page in the 2026-27 catalog; the #page=242 link appears to point to the wrong section.

Part 2: The supplied catalog text (PDF pages 242-245) contains no CalGETC Certificate of Achievement section; it prints the Paralegal Studies A.A./Certificate, the Paralegal Associate Degree local General Education pattern, and the AA-T in Law, Public Policy, and Society. The source link likely points to the wrong page; a reviewer should locate the CalGETC certificate section.
Part 2: No blocks recorded because no requirements for the named award are printed. The Paralegal local GE list is a different GE pattern and GE courses never go in blocks.
Part 2: No outcomes or careers for the CalGETC certificate appear in the text; outcomes printed belong to the Paralegal certificate and the Law AA-T and were not recorded.
Read in 2 parts, because one reply could not hold the whole record.
